user_prompt: I need to pull together both our internal capability analysis to see if we're adequately staffed for the upcoming changes we're planning, and simultaneously check our procurement records to ensure all our vendor relationships maintain proper safety standings before we move forward with any new initiatives.

steps.step_name: Analyze our internal staffing levels and capabilities to determine if we have adequate resources for the upcoming planned changes.
Review our procurement records and vendor relationships to verify that all vendors maintain proper safety certifications and standings.

intent_resolver.reason: The user's request combines two distinct ad-hoc assessments (internal staffing capability and vendor safety standing verification) rather than a single end-to-end process, and no registered skill encompasses both analyses as an integrated workflow.

sub_queries: Pull together our internal capability analysis to see if we're adequately staffed for the upcoming changes we're planning
Check our procurement records to ensure all our vendor relationships maintain proper safety standings before we move forward with new initiatives
